description: Junta de Andalucía: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Andalucía. Coverage: Junta de Andalucía. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plan Andaluz de la Bicicleta. PAB 2014-2020; Precios públicos de los servicios de transporte de la Línea 1 del metr; Inventario de puestos de trabajo de Canal Sur Radio y Televisión, S.A; Inventario de puestos de trabajo de la Agencia Pública de Puertos de A. Formats seen: SPREADSHEET, MS-EXCEL, OCTET-STREAM, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://juntadeandalucia.es/informacion/legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
